The test image shows a soybean leaf with small, circular/rounded dark spots scattered across the surface. Some spots have lighter centers with darker borders, and a few appear to have shot holes. Key features: small circular lesions, reddish-brown/dark coloring, possible gray centers, scattered distribution.

Top candidates: Frogeye_leaf_spot, Bacterial_Pustule, Septoria_brown_spot, Phyllosticta_leaf_spot. Let me compare references.

Frogeye matches well — circular spots with darker borders, some shot holes on green leaf. Bacterial_Pustule shows more numerous, smaller reddish spots with yellow halos. Let me check Septoria for comparison.

Septoria_brown_spot shows extensive yellowing with numerous tiny dark spots on yellowed leaves — doesn't match the test image which has a green leaf with scattered larger circular spots.

**Analysis summary:**
- Test image: green soybean leaf, scattered circular spots (~10-15 spots), dark reddish-brown color, some with lighter centers/darker borders, a few shot holes
- **Frogeye_leaf_spot**: best match — circular spots on green leaves, some with darker outlines, shot holes forming, very similar pattern to test image (especially upper-right panel of collage)
- Bacterial_Pustule: more numerous, smaller reddish spots with yellow halos — doesn't match
- Septoria_brown_spot: requires extensive leaf yellowing — doesn't match
